description: This file defines the SameasTest class, a custom Twig test that checks if two variables are identical (using ===). It extends the TestExpression class and implements the compile method to generate the comparison code.

classes.name: SameasTest
classes.description: A Twig test class that verifies if a variable is the same as another using the strict comparison operator (===).

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code that performs a strict equality check (===) between a node and an argument node within the Twig templating engine.
